title: Reporting Subscription Coverage
description: How one principal-level reporting subscription applies to one account (experimental, media_buy.reporting_subscriptions), returned in get_reporting_status. covered lists each buy's immutable covered_from so a buyer can derive the periods it is owed and tell a missing report (covered, period owed, nothing delivered) from a buy that was never covered. Every uncovered account or buy appears in excluded with a reason. Like every get_reporting_status field it is readable only while the caller is authorized for the account; loss of authority is reported in the caller's own get_principal subscription state.

ReportingSubscriptionExclusionReason.title: Reporting Subscription Exclusion Reason
ReportingSubscriptionExclusionReason.description: offering_unsupported: no offering matches the selector for this account or buy. unauthorized: the principal is not authorized for this buy. overridden: a sync_accounts delivery config, or an account_ids subscription replacing an all-accounts one, takes this account and feed_purpose. capacity: beyond the seller's max_accounts or an account it will not serve. excluded_by_buyer: listed in exclude_account_ids.

status.description: Account-level status. active: the subscription serves this account; individual buys may still be excluded. excluded: the whole account is excluded, with an excluded entry that has no media_buy_id. action_required: the seller will serve the account only after pending_action completes.

pending_action.description: What must happen before the seller serves this account. Present when and only when status is action_required.

covered.description: Coverage intervals, one per (media_buy_id, offering_id, covered_from). The offering is pinned per entry: a change in resolution ends the entry at a period boundary and starts a new one. A buy covered again after a re-grant without backfill gets a new entry with a new covered_from; with backfill_on_regrant the original entry continues.

covered_from.description: Immutable. Every complete period whose start is at or after this instant is owed; a mid-period value starts coverage at the next boundary, and periods are never clipped.

covered_until.description: Period boundary ending coverage, when known: the buy's final period end, the first boundary at or after deactivation, the last boundary at or before a loss of authority not backfilled on re-grant, or the boundary where a new offering resolution starts. Periods ending after it are not owed.

excluded.description: Accounts or buys this subscription does not serve. An entry without media_buy_id excludes the whole account.

overridden_by.description: The subscription or sync_accounts delivery config that replaces this one. Present when and only when reason is overridden.

gaps.description: Intervals between loss of authority and re-grant that the seller did not backfill (backfill_on_regrant false or absent). Periods overlapping a gap are not owed. A backfilled interval is not a gap.

examples.description: Account covered by an all-accounts subscription, one buy without a matching offering
